rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for pulling back, especially a military withdrawal.

example.english: The defenders retreat as soon as the enemy approaches.
example.traditional: 見到敵軍逼近，守軍就即刻撤退。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 dik6 gwan1 bik1 gan6 sau2 gwan1 zau6 zik1 hak1 cit3 teoi3

rows.note: Use this for military forces withdrawing from a position or battle, and it is the standard all-purpose choice for that sense.

example.english: The enemy forces began to retreat, and only then did we enter the city.
example.traditional: 敵軍開始撤退，我哋先至入城。
example.jyutping: dik6 gwan1 hoi1 ci2 cit3 teoi3 ngo5 dei6 sin1 zi3 jap6 seng2

rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when a person or group physically moves back from a position.

example.english: You are standing too close, so retreat a little.
example.traditional: 你企得太埋喇，退後少少啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 kei5 dak1 taai3 maai4 laa3 teoi3 hau6 siu2 siu2 laa1

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when someone goes back to an earlier place or position rather than merely stepping backward.

example.english: It is too dangerous here, so let us retreat to the entrance and wait.
example.traditional: 呢度太危險，我哋退返去門口等啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 taai3 ngai4 him2 ngo5 dei6 teoi3 faan1 heoi3 mun4 hau2 dang2 laa1

rows.note: Use this when a retreat is a safe haven, rather than merely a quiet private place.

example.english: For many stray cats, this garden is a retreat.
example.traditional: 對好多流浪貓嚟講，呢個花園係一個避風港。
example.jyutping: deoi3 hou2 do1 lau4 long6 maau1 lai4 gong2 ni1 go3 faa1 jyun2 hai6 jat1 go3 bei6 fung1 gong2

rows.note: Use this for an organized Christian or spiritual retreat involving seclusion, prayer, or meditation.

example.english: The church is holding a retreat next month, where everyone will pray and meditate.
example.traditional: 教會下個月搞退修會，大家會一齊祈禱同靜修。
example.jyutping: gaau3 wui2 haa5 go3 jyut6 gaau2 teoi3 sau1 wui5 daai6 gaa1 wui5 jat1 cai4 kei4 tou2 tung4 zing6 sau1
